mechanism: python-novaclient 16.0 removes novaclient.v2.list_extensions, causing Horizon API module import failure before an existing Nova API unit test
repair_template: Remove the obsolete novaclient list_extensions import and route, and use the existing extension support surface

semantic_review.a1_failure: With only that constraint revision, importing Horizon's Nova API module raises ImportError for novaclient.v2.list_extensions before the unchanged existing ComputeApiTests.test_server_reboot body can run; the same command must pass with 15.1.0 and after the maintainer repair.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Independent inspection of the one-line source constraint diff, the complete four-file maintainer diff, cutoff command provenance in tox.ini, and fresh three-arm command logs with installed versions 15.1.0/16.0.0/16.0.0 and an A1-exclusive normalized ImportError signature.
semantic_review.source_effect: The opening revision changes only the python-novaclient global constraint from 15.1.0 to 16.0.0; version 16.0.0 no longer exports novaclient.v2.list_extensions, which the cutoff Horizon Nova API module imports at module load time.
semantic_review.target_repair: The full maintainer patch removes the obsolete production import and REST route, implements extension_supported through the already-valid blacklist surface, and adds a discovered test for that behavior. It neither deletes nor skips the selected pre-existing server reboot test; the removed underscore-prefixed _test_extension_list helper was not a discovered test.
